hooks.name: Constants sync test on constants or engine save
hooks.description: When shared/constants.json or scripts/mcp_game_server.py is saved, run scripts/test_constants_sync.py if it exists.

action.command: if [ -f scripts/test_constants_sync.py ]; then python3 -B scripts/test_constants_sync.py; else echo 'skip: scripts/test_constants_sync.py does not exist yet'; fi
